news.analysis: Allen did not attempt a single rush all game. It was not his best performance overall as a result, though he still threw for over 300 yards. He'll take on the Chiefs next on Thursday.
news.contents: Josh Allen completed 27-of-45 passes for 304 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.title: Josh Allen throws for 304 yards Sunday

news.contents: Once again, plenty is expected from Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen in Week 11, as he is RotoBaller's second-ranked quarterback with Buffalo preparing to take on the Miami Dolphins on Sunday afternoon. Allen is projected to score 24 fantasy points coming off a successful effort against the New York Jets last week. news.title: Josh Allen Keeping it Rolling

news.analysis: Allen and Breece Hall combined for 151 rushing yards in the close win over Los Angeles. Allen continues to see a solid workload despite sharing time with Hall, giving both running backs standalone fantasy value. He will be a flex option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.
news.contents: Braelon Allen carried the ball 16 times for 75 yards and caught a nine-yard pass in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.title: Braelon Allen runs for 75 yards in Week 11

news.contents: New York Jets running back Breece Hall has scored 11.7 and 14.8 PPR points in his two games back from a quadriceps injury that cost him five games. Seven catches supplied 93 of his 195 scrimmage yards in that span, and he drew four targets in each game. That receiving work makes him a reasonable RB2 in 12-team PPR leagues for Sunday's road game against the Los Angeles Chargers. RotoBaller ranks him RB16 for Week 11 in PPR. Hall had 26 carries over those two games, and Braelon Allen took eight ...
news.title: Breece Hall's Week 11 Outlook Depends on Scoring Format

news.contents: Chicago Bears running back Roschon Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to return to the Week 11 game against the New Orleans Saints due to an ankle injury, the team announced. Johnson was injured in the first quarter and was carted off to Chicago's locker room after spending time in the blue medical tent. Johnson did not record any statistics before exiting the contest. Chicago's top-two running backs, D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai, are available for the Bears.
news.title: Roschon Johnson Doubtful to Return Against Saints with Ankle Injury

news.analysis: McMillan found the end zone on a seven yard reception in the second quarter, marking his fourth touchdown of the season. McMilan and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in a divisional matchup in Week 12.
news.contents: Tetairoa McMillan caught 6-of-9 targets for 71 yards and one touchdown in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.title: Tetairoa McMillan finds the end zone in Week 11 win

news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan had a big game in his team's Week 11 win over the Baltimore Ravens, recording six catches for 71 yards and a touchdown on nine targets. It was a nice bounce-back performance for the 23-year-old, who was held to just three catches for 35 yards on seven targets by the New Orleans Saints in Week 10. Across nine games before getting injured, the 27-year-old recorded 19 catches for 136 yards and four touchdowns on 27 targets. news.contents: The Arizona Cardinals officially downgraded rookie quarterback Carson Beck (back) to out for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs due to back spasms, according to Darren Urban of the team's official website. Veteran journeyman Josh Johnson will make his first start for the Cardinals in Week 11 against KC. Beck's back spasms resurfaced this week, and he is now out after failing to practice on Friday. He continues to split opportunities with Kenyon Sadiq for the Jets, posting 24 catches for 192 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this year. He will be on the TE3 radar in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.
